$comment: x-status: partial — v1 omits recv-side filters (since, min_seq, reply_to, sender). Use the replay operation for since-based retrieval. Client-side filtering is the v1 pattern for reply_to/sender. See TODOs: since-parameter-on-recv-accept, filter-recv-by-reply-to-and-sender.
title: {{recv_tool}} — input
description: Input schema for the SOX recv (drain) operation. Non-blocking: returns immediately with whatever messages have accumulated in the agent's local mailbox since the last drain. An empty result is always valid. Calling with no arguments drains all subscribed channels. Normative reference: spec/ports/backing-store.md §2.2 and spec/protocol.md.

channels.description: Optional list of channel names to drain. When null or omitted, all channels the calling agent is subscribed to are drained. When provided, only messages from the listed channels are returned; messages from other channels remain in the mailbox.

max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to return in a single call. Within each channel, the oldest messages (lowest seq) are returned first up to this limit. Default: 50.

thread_depth.description: Controls inline expansion of reply-chain ancestors. 0 (default): only reply_to message IDs are included on each message — no ancestor envelopes. n > 0: n ancestor envelopes are inlined per message. -1: full ancestor chain is inlined (server cap applies; default server max: 50 levels). Agents choose the depth per-call to balance context cost vs. thread visibility. Normative reference: docs/decisions/threading-depth.md.

include_meta.description: When true (default), each returned message carries a '_meta' object with trace_id, middleware_timings, and server_node_id. When false, '_meta' is omitted from all returned messages. Per-request override of the server-level default (set by deployment configuration). Normative reference: docs/decisions/observability-meta-mode.md.
